items.text: Hypothesis: Manually reconciling order and financial data between the acquired Dahl technical trade units and Kesko's existing systems during integration — Public clue: Inferred from the Dahl deal: separate brands and units may require manual reconciliation of order and financial data; this is an inference, not a confirmed process (~12 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Re-keying tender and supplier award details from public procurement notices into internal records — Public clue: Several Kesko entities appear as winners in Finnish public tenders on TED; matching awards across units may involve manual checks (estimate of workload, unconfirmed) (~4 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Handling multi-brand register and naming changes across units (for example the 2025 name registrations) in downstream systems — Public clue: Six name registrations appear in the company register in late 2025; whether these trigger manual updates is unknown (~3 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Manual checking of warehouse order flows during a new cloud warehouse rollout across five distribution centres — Public clue: Kesko selected Manhattan Associates' ActiveWarehouse for five distribution centres; parallel-running and data checks during rollout are a common but unconfirmed workload (~6 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Collating quarterly and rights-issue reporting data from multiple divisions for investor materials — Public clue: Q3 interim report due 29 October 2026 and a proposed rights issue of €500-700m with an EGM on 30 October 2026; data collation across divisions is an assumption (~5 h/week, estimate)

blocks.text: Estimate: Hours are scenario estimates built from the timing of public events and general integration patterns, not measurements of any internal process; the whole card is hypothetical and should be validated with the client. Public evidence only; the real numbers come from a conversation.

blocks.label: Note to the COO (with the card)
blocks.text: Hi [Name], we noticed Kesko's Dahl integration and the Q3 reporting timetable land close together. We wondered if teams are reconciling order and financial data across the acquired units by hand. If there is a ghost doing that, we would love to hear how it works. If not, we are happy to be wrong. Worth a 20-minute chat?
